about: How hard each dungeon fights (logic/Content/DungeonFights.cs). Measured by `dotnet run --project godot/balance -- dungeon --seeds 50` at the dungeon's entry level (hollow 6, roost 7, gear 1). Targets (the owner 15 Nov: a playable demo of two dungeons; DEMO_PLAN H6 'the player must move'): stand-still bot falls in 80%+ of runs; the late-reacting human clears 70-90%; the deft bot 95%+; something to dodge every 45-60 s of fighting; median run 6-12 min; Bladestorm 20-35% of her damage. Retuned 15 Nov on the merged tree (castMove off, warden-turn): hollow human 88/88%, roost 86/84% on seeds 1-50 / 51-100.
